messages.全攻撃スキルで破裂回数を補い、破裂編成の回数を維持しつつ、挑発値と自己回復で攻撃: An Identity that adds Rupture Count with every attack skill to sustain a Rupture team, while taking enemy attacks through Aggro and self-healing.
messages.破裂回数の維持: 破裂は被ダメージのたびに回数が1減る。S1「噛み砕いてやろう！: **Maintaining Rupture Count**: Rupture loses 1 Count each time the bearer takes damage. S1 I Shall Nibble Thee! has 1 Coin and adds +2 Count on hit, so it is a net gain. S3 Whirlwind Om-Nom-Nom! adds +3 with Coin Ⅰ and loses 3 from its 3 Coin hits, so she can attack without reducing Count (reusing Coin Ⅲ below 50% HP costs 1 more).
messages.S2「発光擬餌」で破裂を始動: 3コインで破裂1・1・2を付与する。Ⅲコインの的: **Starting Rupture with S2 Flashing Lure**: 3 Coins inflicting 1, 1, and 2 Rupture. On hit, Coin Ⅲ increases the target's Rupture Count by 2/3 if it is 2 or less. It serves as the starter against targets without Rupture or with little Count left.
messages.破裂6以上で強化: S2・S3は対象の破裂が6以上でコイン威力+1。守備「カチカ: **Bonuses at 6+ Rupture**: S2 and S3 gain +1 Coin Power if the target has at least 6 Rupture. Her Defense skill Chattering Teeth gains +3 Final Power.
messages.回復: S3のⅢコインの的中時に体力を10/15回復し、さらに対象の破裂1につき: **Healing**: On hit, Coin Ⅲ of S3 heals 10/15 HP plus 1/2 per Rupture on the target, up to 20/40. Below 50% HP, Coin Ⅲ is reused once, healing 50% more on reuse. Her Defense skill heals HP equal to the remaining Shield at Turn End, once per turn, up to 10% of her max HP.
messages.挑発とバトルパッシブ「ガツガツむしゃむしゃ」(暴食×4・保有・同期化Ⅱで取得):: **Aggro and the combat passive Om Nom Nom (4 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ)**: On use, S1–S3 give that slot Aggro next turn, which matters in Focused Encounters. Through the passive, she gains +1 Clash Power while she has Aggro and heals 4/6 HP each time she hits an enemy that targets her attack skills.
messages.破裂編成に入れ、S2で破裂を付け、S1で回数を足し、S3で回数を保ったまま攻撃し: Put her in a Rupture team: apply Rupture with S2, add Count with S1, and attack with S3 while keeping Count, so allies' Rupture never runs out. In Focused Encounters, draw enemy attacks with Aggro and endure by hitting the enemies that target her while healing. Her Clash Power is modest and weak in opening Clashes, so early on she mainly uses her Defense skill and one-sided attacks. The support passive Illumilantern (5 Gluttony Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅲ) gives the same kind of healing to the ally with the highest Aggro.
